assertions: The desktop Agent workspace uses a fixed-height shell so the left history/image column does not grow with the conversation.
The right-hand conversation viewport owns vertical scrolling while the composer and left column stay in place.
The waiting copy derives from the same running activity object rendered by the execution timeline, so model progress cannot display the context-step copy.
red_test: A long conversation must keep the left column bounded, and a running model activity must not leave the bottom status text on the context step.
green_test: npm run test:agent -> 10 passed, 0 failed; npm run lint, npm run typecheck, and git diff --check passed.
same_case_requirement: Issue #4 sidebar growth and Issue #6 progress/copy mismatch are addressed without closing either issue before external retest.
